rate_consistency.reason: The source provides observed total diabetes prevalence but no jointly estimated opening complication prevalences and transition rates.
rate_consistency.runtime_policy: Preserve observed total diabetes prevalence, initialise undeclared complication prevalences as documented, leave transition rates unchanged, and report any early runtime movement.

purpose: Allocate observed opening diabetes prevalence to the diabetes state, initialise unobserved complication states to zero, and calculate the disease-free residual before the first model year.

residual_state.meaning: People outside the diabetes states in this marginal disease partition.

zero_states.meaning: Diabetic retinopathy has no separate observed opening prevalence input.
Lower-extremity amputation has no separate observed opening prevalence input.
Diabetic nephropathy has no separate observed opening prevalence input.

method_boundaries: Observed diabetes prevalence is authoritative for the opening diabetes stock.
The three complication states begin at zero because the source module declares no separate observed opening prevalence for them.
No disease rate is changed by this opening-state method.
The disease-free residual and diabetes states conserve the demographic population in every age-sex cell.
